column1: # TITLE: Transcriptomic analysis of two human non-small-cell lung cancer cell lines in response to SN1 methylating-agents treatment
# SUMMARY: Methylating agents of SN1 type constitute a widely used class of anticancer drugs
column2: the effect of which on human non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) has not been adequately studied. We thus studied the effect of N-methyl-N-nitrosourea (MNU)
column4: on two human NSCLC cell lines: A549 (p53wt) and H157 (p53null). We investigated the mechanism of MNU-induced cell death through a time course gene expression profiling study
